--- assistant 1
<write path="canon/orders.cn">
use catalog.{CatalogError, Product, find, products}
use users.{users}

table orders: Order key id

type Line {
  sku: String,
  quantity: Int,
}

type Order {
  id: Int,
  email: String,
  lines: List[Line],
  total: Int,
  status: Status,
}

type Status =
  | Open
  | Paid(receipt: String)
  | Cancelled

type NewOrder {
  email: String,
  lines: List[Line],
}

type Summary {
  email: String,
  orders: Int,
  spent: Int,
}

fn line_total(l: Line) -> Int
  effects: store(products)
  ensures: result >= 0
{
  return match find(l.sku) {
    Ok(p) => p.cents * l.quantity,
    Err(_) => 0,
  }
}

api fn place_order(input: NewOrder) -> Result[Order, CatalogError]
  route: POST "/orders"
  effects: store(orders), store(products)
  requires: len(input.lines) > 0
{
  var total = 0
  for line in input.lines {
    let p = try find(line.sku)
    total = total + p.cents * line.quantity
  }
  let order = Order {
    id: next_id(orders),
    email: input.email,
    lines: input.lines,
    total: total,
    status: Open,
  }
  insert(orders, order)
  return Ok(order)
}

api fn pay(id: Int) -> Result[Order, CatalogError]
  route: POST "/orders/{id}/pay"
  effects: net(payments.example.com), store(orders)
{
  return match get(orders, id) {
    Some(o) => match http_post("https://payments.example.com/charge", to_string(o.total)) {
      Ok(receipt) => Ok(save(orders, paid(o, receipt))),
      Err(e) => Err(Missing(e.message)),
    },
    None => Err(Missing("order " + to_string(id))),
  }
}

fn paid(o: Order, receipt: String) -> Order {
  var out = o
  out.status = Paid(receipt)
  return out
}

api fn summaries() -> List[Summary]
  route: GET "/summaries"
  effects: store(orders)
{
  let groups = group_by(scan(orders), |o| o.email)
  let rows = map(
    groups,
    |g| Summary { email: g.0, orders: len(g.1), spent: fold(g.1, 0, |acc, o| acc + o.total) },
  )
  return sort_desc_by(rows, |s| s.spent)
}

api fn open_count(email: String) -> Int
  route: GET "/orders/open"
  effects: store(orders)
{
  var n = 0
  for o in scan(orders) {
    if o.email == email {
      n = n + (match o.status {
        Open => 1,
        _ => 0,
      })
    }
  }
  return n
}

api fn customers() -> List[(String, Int)]
  route: GET "/customers"
  effects: store(orders), store(users)
{
  let names = map(scan(users), |u| u.name)
  return map(enumerate(names), |i, n| (n, i + count(orders)))
}

api fn first_email() -> Option[String]
  route: GET "/orders/first"
  effects: store(orders)
{
  let all = scan(orders)
  return match first(all) {
    Some(o) => Some(o.email),
    None => None,
  }
}

api fn list_orders(email: String, page: Int, per_page: Int) -> List[Order]
  route: GET "/orders"
  effects: store(orders)
  requires: page >= 1 && per_page >= 1 && per_page <= 20
{
  let all = sort_by(scan(orders), |o| o.id)
  let for_user = filter(all, |o| o.email == email)
  return take(drop(for_user, (page - 1) * per_page), per_page)
}

```python
"""The FastAPI app. canon build writes this file once and never changes it again: it is yours."""

import os

from fastapi import FastAPI

from canon_generated import store
from canon_generated.api import router
from canon_generated.net import Http, http
from canon_generated.runtime import Error, Ok, Result, install

# The database file: $SHOP_DATABASE, default shop.db.
os.environ.setdefault("CANON_DATABASE", os.environ.get("SHOP_DATABASE", "shop.db"))

app = FastAPI()
install(app)
app.include_router(router)


def reset_database() -> None:
    """Forget the open database; the next request opens $SHOP_DATABASE again (tests)."""
    os.environ["CANON_DATABASE"] = os.environ.get("SHOP_DATABASE", "shop.db")
    store.reset()


class FakePayments(Http):
    """Approves every charge without calling the payment provider (tests and demos)."""

    def post(self, url: str, body: str) -> Result[str, Error]:
        return Ok(f"test-receipt-{body}")


if os.environ.get("SHOP_FAKE_PAYMENTS") == "1":
    payments = "payments.example.com"
    app.dependency_overrides[http(payments)] = lambda: FakePayments(payments)
```
